acceptanceCriteria: The 10-pair development variance run and the frozen pair count are recorded in a build-log entry before the held-out selection is drawn.
The held-out manifest is selected with the amended rule, excludes the pilot, and its digest is recorded before any lane runs.

The three-arm report is committed unrepaired and README's CEM row is rewritten from its summary.arms, seed_coverage and contrasts with the wording decision 0427 names for a positive and for a null result; the row says agent reviewer, never reviewer, until the reviewer-projection ticket's human leg runs.
body: Decision 0427 / build-log 2026-10-01 / CRT-V0-004, CRT-V0-005, CRT-V0-007, CRT-V0-008, CRT-V0-012 as amended. The 2026-09-04 pilot's treatment carried no evidence and three of its five changes had gold no arm could cite; it answers nothing about CEM. Procedure: accept or amend the CRT-V0 amendments; draw a 10-pair development run first to estimate the between-change variance of the per-change delta; freeze the pair count from amended CRT-V0-008 (about 55 pairs for a 20% relative reduction from a corrected control miss of 0.50 with two repeats); select with `cem-trial select --partition heldout --exclude tools/cem-trial/testdata/pilot/tasks.json` under the reachable-gold rule; run once with `--arms control,treatment,seeded --repeats 2` at a fixed model and effort; preserve the first report unrepaired at benchmarks/results/cem-reviewer-trial-first-run.json. Read the result as retrieval (seed_coverage.fraction) times adoption (1 - miss_given_suggested); a fraction below 0.5 is retrieval-limited and supports no claim about the map. Budget from the pilot: about 250 s and 1.1M input tokens per lane, so about 330 lanes.
title: Run the three-arm sealed CEM reviewer trial with the amended cem-trial (about 55 pairs, two repeats)
